title: Grateful Dead Live at Marin County Veterans Auditorium on 1983-10-30
source: Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (TDK SA-X90)Transfer Info: Cassette (Sony TC-WE475/Azimuth Adjusted) -> Apogee Mini-Me (16/44.1k) -> USB -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> SHN (2 Discs Audio / 2 Discs SHN) via Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Muddy soundboard mix with buried guitars but a solid above‑average performance.
ai_review.review: Reviewers agree the show is slightly better than average, though the recording suffers from a muddy mix that buries Jerry's guitar and muffles Bob's vocals. The tape appears to be a soundboard source with possible PA or cassette generation issues, making the audio quality poor despite the decent playing.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is noted as above average (≈3.5/5) while recording quality is described as muddy and poor (≈2/5). Weighted combination yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is very muddy; Jerry's guitar often buried, Bob's vocals muffled/distorted. Likely PA or board problems and possible late‑generation cassette degradation.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance described as just above average with no specific set‑list issues mentioned.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar often buried in the mix, possibly due to his loud on‑stage amp.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals muffled and distorted on several numbers.
